shortDescription: Configure Rudder Nodes parameters via APIs

options.name: agent_key
options.description: Define information about agent key or certificate

options.name: include
options.description: Level of information to include from the node inventory.

options.name: node_id
options.description: Define the identifier of the node to be configured

options.name: policy_mode
options.description: Set the policy mode to (default, enforce or audit)

options.name: properties
options.description: Define a list of properties (with "name:" and "value:")

options.name: query
options.description: The criterion you want to find for your nodes.

options.name: rudder_token
options.description: Providing Rudder server token. Defaults to the content of /var/rudder/run/api-token if not set.

options.name: rudder_url
options.description: Providing Rudder server IP address. Defaults to localhost.

options.name: state
options.description: Set the node life cycle state to (enabled, ignored, empty-policies, initializing or preparing-eol)

options.name: status
options.description: Set the status of the (pending) node

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Choosing either to ignore or not Rudder certificate validation. Defaults to true.
